name: GC disable linearizes after every admitted safe-point publication

payload.q_claim: outer transaction prevents OFF from returning before this round is durably ordered
payload.fault: ordinary SET GLOBAL tidb_gc_enable=OFF after the enable read

name: Disable GC before migration or historical recovery

payload.production_story: An operator or automation disables GC before a DR migration, snapshot investigation, or recovery workflow and verifies @@global.tidb_gc_enable=0 as documented. The command overlaps the periodic GC prepare after it reads ON.
requires: overlap after the enable read and before safe-point metadata commit
